{"script":"mkdir -p /working/temp_workspace
echo /working/temp_workspace > /working/temp_workspace/recorded_path.txt
find /working -print > /working/temp_workspace/raw_listing.txt
( while IFS= read -r p; do [ -f "$p" ] && printf '%s\n' "$p"; done < /working/temp_workspace/raw_listing.txt ) > /working/temp_workspace/regular_files.txt
( while IFS= read -r p; do readlink -f "$p"; done < /working/temp_workspace/regular_files.txt ) | sort -u > /working/temp_workspace/normalized_files.txt
( while IFS= read -r p; do [ "$(basename "$p")" = "workspace" ] && printf '%s\n' "$p"; done < /working/temp_workspace/normalized_files.txt ) > /working/temp_workspace/matches.txt
found=0
while IFS= read -r p; do [ -f "$p" ] && { found=1; break; }; done < /working/temp_workspace/matches.txt
if [ "$found" -eq 1 ]; then echo true > /working/temp_workspace/present.flag; else echo false > /working/temp_workspace/present.flag; fi
if grep -q '^true$' /working/temp_workspace/present.flag 2>/dev/null; then echo yes > /working/temp_workspace/result_ready.txt; else echo no > /working/temp_workspace/result_ready.txt; fi
cat /working/temp_workspace/result_ready.txt
"}
